tool.remove: Delete an installed Skill (can't be undone). Built-in Skills can't be deleted.
tool.pack: Pack a Skill as <name>.skill in the session's working directory and return the path.
tool.list: List installed Skills: name, description, source (bundled or installed), and whether each is enabled.
tool.edit: Change one file in an existing Skill (path defaults to SKILL.md). Use one of: content to replace the whole file (creating it if missing); old_text + new_text to replace a unique snippet exactly; delete=true to delete the file (SKILL.md can't be deleted). Editing a built-in Skill first copies it as an installed one.
tool.read: Read a Skill file. Reads SKILL.md (the Skill's instructions) by default; path can name another file in the Skill folder, such as references/xxx.md. Read long files in parts, using next_offset as offset. The returned directory is the Skill's folder, for running its scripts with the shell.
tool.install: Install a Skill from a local file or folder: a .skill / .zip package, a single SKILL.md, or a folder containing SKILL.md. For a Skill file someone sent in the chat, download it with qq_file_download first, then pass the returned path here. Relative paths are based on the session's working directory. Set replace=true to overwrite an installed Skill with the same name.
tool.create: Create a Skill. skill_md is the full SKILL.md, which must start with YAML frontmatter containing name (same as the name argument; lowercase letters, digits, hyphens) and description (what it does and when to use it); files can add other text files (relative paths under references/, scripts/, assets/). Fails if a Skill with that name exists; set replace=true only to really overwrite it.

sendHint: Use qq_file_send to send this .skill file to them
